content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Authorize.net Webhooks, Live Mode ## slug: payments-deploy-production-authorizenet-webhooks ## seoTitle: Authorize.net Webhooks, Live Mode ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (Important) To use the following instructions, you must have Salesforce administrator access to Salesforce and Authorize.net. ::: Once you have connected to {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, it's time to configure webhooks. Webhooks automatically send specified data from {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. 1. Go to Setup. 2. Type “Sites” in the Quick Find box. 3. Click Sites. 4. If a Force.com domain has not been set up, follow the instructions to create one. If have have a Force.com domain, go to the next step. ## Configure your Site 1. Enter a value for your Force.com domain. 2. Click **Check Availability**. 3. Review and accept the Site terms of use. 4. Click **Register My Force.com Domain**. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_1.png){height="" width=""} 6. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to Sites. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_2.png){height="" width=""} 8. Set {{variable.Field_Site_SiteLabel}} = "Webhook". ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_3.png){height="" width=""} 10. The {{variable.Field_Site_SiteName}} field will auto populate. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_4.png){height="" width=""} 12. In {{variable.Field_Site_DefaultWebAddress}}, type in the same name you used for the {{variable.Field_Site_SiteLabel}}. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_5.png){height="" width=""} 14. Set {{variable.Field_Site_Active}} = “True”. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_6.png){height="" width=""} 16. Click the **Active Site Home Page** lookup. This will open a new window. 17. Click InMaintenance. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_7](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_7.png){height="" width=""} 19. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_8](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_8.png){height="" width=""} 21. Click the newly created {{variable.Field_Site_SiteLabel}}. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_9](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_9.png){height="" width=""} 23. Click **Public Access Settings**. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_10](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_10.png){height="" width=""} 25. Click **Assigned Users**. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_11](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_11.png){height="" width=""} 27. Click Site Guest User, Webhook. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_12](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_12.png){height="" width=""} 29. Add the {{variable.PS_PT_SiteGuestUser}} permission set to this user's record. * For users who want to set up webhooks with a Payments package older than v5.6, you will need to add the Blackthorn | Payments (Webhooks) permission set. You will also need to add a Sharing Rule to allow the Site Guest User to access the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object. * For packages v5.6 and later, the {{variable.PS_PT_SiteGuestUser}} permission set is now a dual-purpose permission set. This permission set will be used for webhook setup and REST API setup. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_13](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_13.png){height="" width=""} ## Go to Authorize.net 1. Log into your [test or production account](https://logintest.authorize.net/?cobrand=sandbox&sub=oauth&client_id=8FmLgAg1pC&state=https%3a%2f%2fblackthornio-ad-dev-ed.my.salesforce.com%2fapex%2fbt_stripe__PaymentGateway_AuthCallback%3ba0M8c00000dS4X0%3b&scope=read%2cwrite&redirect_uri=https%3a%2f%2fpayments-auth.blackthorn.io%2foauthRedirect2){target="_blank"}. 2. Click **ACCOUNT**. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_14](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_14.png){height="" width=""} 4. Click Webhooks. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_15](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_15.png){height="" width=""} 6. Click **Add Endpoint**. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_16](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_16.png){height="" width=""} 8. Define a {{variable.Field_AuthNet_Name}} for the endpoint. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_17](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_17.png){height="" width=""} 10. Copy and paste the URL below into the {{variable.Field_Stripe_EndpointURL}} field. "https://SITE_DOMAIN_NAME/SITE_PATH/services/apexrest/bt_stripe/webhook/WEBHOOK_LABEL" ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_18](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_18.png){height="" width=""} 12. Without closing {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, go back to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and copy the Site URL for the Site you created. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_19](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_19.png){height="" width=""} 14. Replace “https://SITE_DOMAIN_NAME/SITE_PATH” with your Site URL. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_20](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_20.png){height="" width=""} 16. Without closing {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, go back to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and click the App Launcher. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_21](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_21.png){height="" width=""} 18. Select Blackthorn | Payments (Admin). ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_22](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_22.png){height="" width=""} 20. Click the Payment Gateways tab. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_23](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_23.png){height="" width=""} 22. Go to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record you want to connect to webhooks and copy the value you placed in the {{variable.Field_PG_WebhookLabel}} field. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_24](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_24.png){height="" width=""} 24. Replace “WEBHOOK_LABEL” with the value from your Payment Gateway. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_25](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_25.png){height="" width=""} 26. Set {{variable.Field_AuthNet_Status}} = “Active”. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_26](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_26.png){height="" width=""} 28. Check {{variable.Field_Authnet_AllEvents}}. ![deploy_authnet_webhooks_27](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_authnet_webhooks_27.png){height="" width=""} 30. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. You have successfully setup your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} webhook!
